material.locator: ILOSTAT LFS database description — Labour force participation rate, Employment and Unemployment; ILOSTAT COND database description — Wages and Working Time; ILOSTAT Data — Labour productivity and Hours of work; ILO resource “Labour underutilization” — three main measures.
material.description: The ILO statistical resources identify employment, unemployment and labour-force participation; earnings and working-time measures; labour productivity indicators; and time-related underemployment, unemployment and potential labour force as measures of labour underutilization. Indicator definitions and statistical standards vary by series and reference period; these are not interchangeable without methodological checks.
